items.reason: A gentle, non-active cleanser keeps the base of your routine simple while you introduce actives.
A morning niacinamide serum suits skin with a slightly shiny look and is an easy first active to layer.
A lower-strength retinol is a sensible starting point for a smoother-looking, more even complexion at night.
A lightweight ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable skin feel and cushions the skin as it adjusts to retinol.
A daily mineral SPF 50 is essential alongside retinol, which makes skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: Mornings: cleanse, niacinamide, moisturizer, then SPF. Evenings: cleanse, then retinol (pea-sized amount) just 2 nights a week at first, building up slowly as your skin tolerates it, followed by moisturizer.
